About

Production readiness, built in from the start

I'm a Cloud & DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience running reliable cloud environments and automated release systems. My focus is production readiness: stability, observability and confidence in every deployment.

I design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, container platforms on Docker and Kubernetes, serverless workloads on AWS, and infrastructure provisioned with Terraform. I add monitoring and alerting so systems stay observable and resilient.

I care about measurable outcomes: faster and safer releases, less operational risk, better uptime, and infrastructure that scales cleanly as the business grows.

  • AWS cloud architecture

    Secure, scalable AWS designs with serverless patterns, networking, IAM and production-grade rollout strategies.

  • CI/CD pipeline engineering

    Automated build, test and deploy workflows with quality gates and rollback-safe releases.

  • Kubernetes & containers

    Containerised services on Docker and Kubernetes for consistent, scalable orchestration.

  • Observability & reliability

    Monitoring, logging and alerting that raise uptime and speed up incident response.
